name: Citizenship by Special Skills/Talent, Investment, National Interest, or Honour

requirements.blocker_text: Demonstrated special skills or talent, supported by an employer recommendation letter.
Substantial, sustainable investment in Rwanda, supported by investor registration documents.
Official government recommendation on national-interest grounds.

outcome.physical_presence_requirement: no minimum residence period is stated for these discretionary grounds

sources.title: Directorate General of Immigration and Emigration (DGIE), Rwanda -- citizenship: special-skills/talent (employer recommendation), substantial-investment (investor registration), and national-interest (official government recommendation) grounds; 6-month processing, 5,000-10,000 RWF fee range across all citizenship categories

The East African (regional newspaper) -- coverage of Rwanda's talent/investment/integrity-based citizenship offer, framing it as an active, publicised recruitment tool rather than a rarely-used legal footnote

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Rwanda). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- the three modeled grounds (talent, investment, national interest) are tier-1 DGIE sourced. NO minimum residence period, investment threshold figure, or explicit selection criteria beyond 'substantial' and 'sustainable' are disclosed by DGIE -- these are inherently discretionary grants (selection_method 'assessed' reflects genuine case-by-case government discretion, not a hidden objective threshold this dataset failed to find). A tier-4 press source (The East African) corroborates that Rwanda actively markets this as a deliberate skilled-migration and investment-attraction tool rather than a dormant legal provision -- cited for context, not as a basis for any hard requirement. This file does NOT model the separate 'honour' ground (Parliament-granted honorary citizenship, analogous to Israel's or other countries' honorary-citizenship provisions in this dataset, typically non-substantive for ordinary applicants) or the 'adoption' ground (folded conceptually into descent-adjacent mechanisms but not independently confirmed in this pass) -- both disclosed as scope limitations rather than modeled.
